objective.statement: Harden the authentication library's password storage and account lockout
objective.success_definition: Passwords are stored hashed and accounts lock after repeated failures

goals.statement: Passwords are hashed with scrypt and a per-user salt before storage
acceptance: No password is stored in a recoverable form

goals.statement: Lock the account after five failed login attempts

constraints.statement: Lock the account after three failed login attempts
Rewrite the login endpoint to return 429 when an account is locked

verification.spec: Confirm no password or hash is written to a log
verification.expected: no log line contains credential material

deliverables.description: A patch to the authentication library
